in_hebrew.name: Imogen
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Imogen הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Imogen is derived from the Old English word igmegean, meaning 'maiden' or 'virgin'. In Shakespeare's play Cymbeline, Imogen is a chaste and devoted princess who faces numerous trials and tribulations but ultimately triumphs over adversity. In Christian tradition, Imogen's name symbolizes purity, devotion, and strength.

in_latin.name: Imogen
in_latin.long_meaning: Imogen nomen femininum est, significans iudicium vel justitiam. Etymologia nominis a lingua Celtica derivata est. Nomen hoc in mythologia Romanorum et in litteris Anglicis saeculi XVI apparuit. Imogen in mythologia Romanorum nomen puellae est, quae iudicium rectum habet et iustitiam servat.
